description: This file contains React custom hooks: 'useGameTimer' for managing a timer with start, stop, and reset functionalities, and 'useKeyboardActivate' for handling keyboard activation via Enter and Space keys.

methods.name: useGameTimer()
methods.description: A React hook providing a timer with controls to start, stop, and reset; tracks elapsed seconds.

methods.name: useKeyboardActivate
methods.description: A React hook that returns a keyboard event handler, activating on Enter or Space keys to trigger a callback.
